subject: Aug Leadership KPI pulse — QBR prep
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aug Leadership KPI pulse — QBR prep

Team — attaching the August KPI dashboard (PDF attached) and a short summary below to use for QBR prep. High-level ask: please review your sections, confirm owner commitments for the asks noted, and drop slide-ready bullets into the QBR folder by EOD Aug 23. QBR is scheduled Aug 28 (exec readout).

Quick summary from the dashboard (top-line numbers):
- 95th pctl latency (prod): 190 ms -> up 22% MoM; tail spikes concentrated in EU region between 18:00-22:00 UTC.
- Backend cost per 1M tokens: $820 -> down 3% MoM, but forecasted to plateau; routing inefficiencies still costing ~8% of spend.
- Uptime (platform): 99.93% in July; one 28-min incident (node OOM) tagged to model rollout. Target for Q4 OKR: 99.95+.
- Active usage (weekly DAU for hosted API): +14% MoM with heavier skew to short-chat workloads.

Action asks (owners & timelines in-line):
1) Latency tail: identify top-3 root causes and mitigation plan (owner: Jonas) — initial findings by Aug 22 EOD, mitigation plan by Aug 25.
2) Cost: quantify routing loss (per-model delta) and propose quick wins (owner: Markus) — proposal by Aug 24.
3) Uptime: final RCA for the OOM incident and hardening checklist (owner: Vivek) — RCA draft by Aug 23.
4) QBR slides: consolidate 1–3 into two slides (metrics readout + ask) and upload to drive (owner: Laura) — slides due Aug 23 10:00 PDT.

Notes: paging Grace for correlation work between request-size distribution and latency tail (Grace: short-chat heavy tail hypothesis). I included links to the dashboard folder and an initial runbook for KV-cache/batching experiments.

Attachments: 202808-monthly-kpi-dashboard.pdf, kv-cache-and-batch-playbook.md

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aug Leadership KPI pulse — QBR prep

Thanks — quick read and a couple of clarifications from infra/serving side:
- The 95p jump lines up with increased concurrent small requests (<= 32 tokens) after the newish client SDK rolled out in mid-July; I think batching behavior changed.
- We saw a cluster of requests routed to older quantized variants that have higher per-token latency under short sequences.

I'll run a short correlation: request-size distribution vs per-model 95p (script in infra repo) and share results by EOD Aug 22. Grace — can you help validate the client SDK telemetry (we may need to get a sample trace)?

On mitigations, I propose: 1) forced batching window bump for short requests on the high-traffic path (A/B for 24h), 2) fast fallback to low-latency variant for requests under 64 tokens. I'll sketch metrics to measure impact.

— Jonas
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aug Leadership KPI pulse — QBR prep

Good notes. I agree routing is a likely contributor to the cost plateau. Two near-term plays I want to run in parallel:
- Routing pruning: drop rarely used slow variants from the primary routing weighted set and push to the cold tier for non-latency-sensitive calls. Can recover ~3–5% spend within 2 weeks.
- Quantization pilot: switch top-3 high-volume models to 4-bit quantization with the updated kernels (risk: slight quality drift). Vivek — can we get a small production canary (5% traffic) for 72h?

I'll prepare a one-slide summary for the QBR with estimated impact and risk matrix. Deliverable: internal proposal by Aug 24.

-Markus
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 17:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aug Leadership KPI pulse — QBR prep

Ack — I'll stand up the canary for quantization and the 5% canary for routing changes. Preliminary plan:
- Today (21 Aug): spin up canary namespace + traffic steering rules (infra ticket INF-4821).
- 22 Aug morning: start traffic ramp to 5% for model A/B (two variants). Monitor latency histograms, error rates, and quality metrics (BLEU/approx semantic similarity).
- 25 Aug: evaluate and decide on wider rollout.

I've added a short runbook to the drive and attached it to the thread (kv-cache-and-batch-playbook.md). See link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-aug-2028-kpis.

Vivek
Site Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aug Leadership KPI pulse — QBR prep

Thanks all — concise plan below that I'll turn into the QBR two-slide bundle and upload by 10:00 PDT today. Please confirm the single-line slide bullets below (I will not expand beyond these for exec time):

Slide 1 — Metrics readout (owner: Irene):
- Latency (95p): 190 ms (+22% MoM). Root cause analysis underway (Jonas) — A/B for batching + variant fallback planned; expected 10–15% 95p reduction if canary succeeds.
- Cost: $820 / 1M tokens; routing pruning + quantization pilot (Markus) expected to drive incremental 8–12% unit cost reduction across heavy models.
- Uptime: 99.93% (one 28-min OOM incident) — RCA and hardening checklist in progress (Vivek); target 99.95+
- Usage: +14% MoM; short-chat skew suggests optimization opportunity on batching/aggregation (Grace).

Slide 2 — Asks (owner + date):
- Jonas: root-cause findings by 2028-08-22 EOD; mitigation A/B plan by 8/25.
- Markus: routing & quantization proposal by 8/24.
- Vivek: RCA draft by 8/23; canary live 8/22.
- Laura: slides uploaded (drive) by 8/23 10:00 PDT.

Please reply only to confirm or flag if anything is missing — thanks, team.

Laura
Head of Inference Reliability
Redwood Inference
